picks.title: NVIDIA Brings Local AI Agents To Its DGX Station Workstation With The NVIDIA Agent Toolkit & Omniverse
picks.excerpt: NVIDIA's Agent Toolkit lets DGX Station users run personal AI agents locally in about 30 minutes, combining Nemotron models and Omniverse libraries so agents can access tools and skills in a secure on-device runtime for creator and dev workflows.
picks.rationale: Fresh, distinct topic (on-device personal-agent runtime via Agent Toolkit + Omniverse) with no match in games history; the published nvidia-siggraph rollup covers neural rendering / Cosmos 3 / MCP-in-DCC-tools, not this local DGX workstation runtime. Actionable for creator/dev pipelines wanting local agents stood up in minutes.

picks.title: "Steam's required AI disclosure is the right move": Devs say gen AI should be called out in games and support Valve's store mandate
picks.excerpt: Developers push back on Tim Sweeney's criticism of Valve's AI labels, arguing disclosure of generative AI content shipped to players is a baseline transparency and creative-credit issue that other storefronts should adopt.
picks.rationale: Distinct event (Sweeney-vs-Valve disclosure debate and developer endorsement of the mandate), separate from the published 07-24 steamcensus card, which is a statistical study of disclosure rates. Adds a policy / creative-credit angle from a different outlet.
